description: How have Dutch house prices moved? Paid ($0.03 USDC): latest month price index (2020=100), average price, sales, 12-month and 5-year change and the last 24 months (CBS table 85773NED, CC BY 4.0). Information, not financial advice. This server holds no wallet and never pays: it returns the HTTP 402 payment requirements (x402 on Base, MPP on Tempo) and the URL https://rent-check-production.up.railway.app/v1/nl-house-prices. Pay with your own x402/MPP client and retry that URL.
name: paid_nl_house_prices
